_doc: Host-relative perf baseline (ms/op). Re-capture on the CI/deploy host: tools/bench.pl --baseline. The gate (--check) fails on >tolerance x regression; a per-op override may live in tolerances{op}. stats_export_ms was added for SM340 and its figure captured 2026-08-17, AFTER the other ops' 2026-07-02 capture: it is a first measurement of an op that previously had none, not a re-capture. The other figures are deliberately untouched - SM327 records that re-capturing them would bake in a measured 9-26% drift and remove the ability to see it. SM342: the work_* entries are COUNTS, not durations, and the gate treats them differently - a count is exact and host-independent, so an increase fails, while a timing is reported with its ratio and never fails. work_warm_* must stay ZERO: a warm call has nothing new to read, and a non-zero value is SM340 returning.
